title: Corpus path accessors and caller-neutral environment for the Papyrus contract
description: Add Corpus methods that return the catalog path, extracted text path for a snapshot and item, and graph manifest path for an extractor and snapshot, with feature specs. Remove PAPYRUS_* environment variable names from grobid_runtime.py in favor of BIBLICUS_* names only.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Decisions: catalog_path already exists as a Corpus property (metadata/catalog.json), so no duplicate is added; it is documented as part of the layout contract. New methods: Corpus.extracted_text_path(extractor_id, snapshot_id, item_id) and Corpus.graph_snapshot_manifest_path(extractor_id, snapshot_id), keyword-only like the existing extraction_snapshot_dir/graph_snapshot_dir. Layout names moved to constants (CATALOG_FILE_NAME, SNAPSHOT_MANIFEST_FILE_NAME, EXTRACTED_TEXT_DIR_NAME, EXTRACTED_TEXT_FILE_SUFFIX) and reused by extraction.py and graph/extraction.py writers. GROBID: drop PAPYRUS_GROBID_* reads, default container name becomes biblicus-grobid. Also fixing the duplicate json_ld layer from blbs-091ac0 (small, same bug).
